strength.title: Strength
strength.whatItMeans: Strength measures physical power, force, and raw muscle.
whatItAffects: Melee attack rolls with Strength-based weapons
strength.exampleInPlay: A character with high Strength might shove open a heavy door, wrestle an enemy to the ground, or haul a fallen ally out of danger.
strength.whyItMatters: If your character fights up close, does physical tasks, or relies on brute force, Strength matters a lot.

dexterity.title: Dexterity
dexterity.whatItMeans: Dexterity measures agility, reflexes, balance, and fine control.
dexterity.exampleInPlay: A character with high Dexterity might dodge a trap, move silently through a hallway, or shoot a bow with precision.
dexterity.whyItMatters: Dexterity affects defense, speed, sneaking, and many common combat actions, so it is useful for a wide range of characters.

constitution.title: Constitution
constitution.whatItMeans: Constitution measures toughness, endurance, and the ability to keep going when things get rough.
whatItAffects: Resistance to sickness, exhaustion, and bodily strain
constitution.exampleInPlay: A character with high Constitution might stay standing after a brutal hit, shrug off poison, or keep a spell going under pressure.
constitution.whyItMatters: Constitution helps a character survive longer in danger, especially in combat or harsh environments.

intelligence.title: Intelligence
intelligence.whatItMeans: Intelligence measures reasoning, memory, study, and analysis.
intelligence.exampleInPlay: A character with high Intelligence might identify a magical sigil, piece together clues from a ruined library, or recognize an old kingdom from a symbol on a shield.
intelligence.whyItMatters: Intelligence is useful when your character learns from books, clues, research, or careful thinking.

wisdom.title: Wisdom
wisdom.whatItMeans: Wisdom measures awareness, intuition, and a character's sense of what is happening around them.
wisdom.exampleInPlay: A character with high Wisdom might notice an ambush before it happens, sense that someone is lying, or find a safe path through the wilderness.
wisdom.whyItMatters: Wisdom helps a character notice danger, read people, and stay grounded in uncertain situations.

charisma.title: Charisma
charisma.whatItMeans: Charisma measures force of personality, confidence, charm, and presence.
charisma.exampleInPlay: A character with high Charisma might talk their way past a guard, command a room, or cast powerful spells through sheer force of personality.
charisma.whyItMatters: Charisma matters when your character influences other people, leads, negotiates, or uses certain types of magic.
